name: videonote
description: Generate AI Markdown notes from video links (Bilibili/YouTube/Douyin/Kuaishou/local)

default_style.title: 笔记风格默认
default_style.description: minimal 精简 / detailed 详细 / academic 学术 / tutorial 教程 / xiaohongshu 小红书 / life_journal 生活向 / task_oriented 任务导向 / business 商业 / meeting_minutes 会议纪要

default_screenshot.title: 笔记默认插图
default_screenshot.description: 生成笔记时默认插入视频截图

video_understanding.title: 视频理解默认
video_understanding.description: 默认把画面抽帧发给多模态 LLM（需多模态模型）

include_comments.title: 弹幕+评论整合默认
include_comments.description: 默认把 B 站弹幕+热门评论整合进笔记（需 SESSDATA）

transcriber_type.title: 语音转写引擎
transcriber_type.description: fast-whisper 本地 / groq / bcut / kuaishou / mlx-whisper

whisper_model_size.title: Whisper 模型尺寸
whisper_model_size.description: tiny / base / small / medium / large-v3 / large-v3-turbo
